English.TITLE: Adhkar for Waking from Sleep

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَمَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after having caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 113 ومسلم 4/ 2083
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Praise be to Allah who restored my health in my body, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي 5/ 473 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 144
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani fi jasadi, wa radda 'alayya ruhi, wa adhina li bidhikrih

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ العَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Almighty. My Lord, forgive me.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 144 وغيرها واللفظ لابن ماجه انظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 335
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, subhanallah, walhamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'azim, Rabbighfir li.
TEXT.NOTE: Whoever wakes in the night and says this, then says “My Lord, forgive me” or makes any supplication, it is answered; and if he then performs ablution and prays, his prayer is accepted.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT:
{إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ (190) الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَى جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ (191) رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ (192) رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ (193) رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ (194) فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لَا أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى بَعْضُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا وَأُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُوا فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُوا وَقُتِلُوا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ثَوَابًا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ (195) لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ (196) مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ (197) لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلًا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِلْأَبْرَارِ (198) وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لَا يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ (199) يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ (200)}
سورة آل عمران، 190 – 200
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT:
{Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of the night and the day, are signs for people of understanding, (190) who remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect upon the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying]: "Our Lord, You have not created this in vain; glory be to You, so protect us from the punishment of the Fire. (191) Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit into the Fire, You have disgraced him, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers. (192) Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying]: 'Believe in your Lord,' and we believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins, remove from us our misdeeds, and cause us to die with the righteous. (193) Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection; indeed You do not fail in [Your] promise." (194) So their Lord answered them: "Indeed I will not let the deed of any worker among you be lost, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated, were expelled from their homes, were harmed in My cause, fought, and were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds and admit them into gardens beneath which rivers flow, as reward from Allah, and Allah has with Him the best of rewards. (195) Let not the movement of the disbelievers throughout the land deceive you. (196) [It is but] a small enjoyment; then their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place. (197) But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as a lodging from Allah, and what is with Allah is best for the righteous. (198) And indeed, among the People of the Book are those who believe in Allah and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, humbling themselves before Allah; they do not sell the verses of Allah for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord; indeed Allah is swift in reckoning. (199) O you who believe, be patient, compete in patience, remain stationed [in readiness], and fear Allah, that you may succeed. (200)}
Surat Aal 'Imran, 190-200
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 8/ 238 ومسلم 1/ 530
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: {Inna fi khalqis-samawati wal-ardi wakhtilafil-layli wan-nahari la'ayatin li-ulil-albab (190) Alladhina yadhkurunallaha qiyaman wa qu'udan wa 'ala junubihim wa yatafakkaruna fi khalqis-samawati wal-ard: Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batilan subhanaka faqina 'adhaban-nar (191) Rabbana innaka man tudkhilin-nara faqad akhzaytah, wa ma liz-zalimina min ansar (192) Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-imani an aminu birabbikum fa'amanna, Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar (193) Rabbana wa atina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika wa la tukhzina yawmal-qiyamah, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad (194) Fastajaba lahum Rabbuhum anni la udi'u 'amala 'amilin minkum min dhakarin aw untha, ba'dukum min ba'd, fal-ladhina hajaru wa ukhriju min diyarihim wa udhu fi sabili wa qatalu wa qutilu la-ukaffiranna 'anhum sayyi'atihim wa la-udkhilannahum jannatin tajri min tahtihal-anharu thawaban min 'indillah, wallahu 'indahu husnuth-thawab (195) La yaghurrannaka taqallubul-ladhina kafaru fil-bilad (196) Mata'un qalil, thumma ma'wahum jahannam, wa bi'sal-mihad (197) Lakinil-ladhinat-taqaw Rabbahum lahum jannatun tajri min tahtihal-anharu khalidina fiha nuzulan min 'indillah, wa ma 'indallahi khayrun lil-abrar (198) Wa inna min ahlil-kitabi laman yu'minu billahi wa ma unzila ilaykum wa ma unzila ilayhim khashi'ina lillahi la yashtaruna bi-ayatillahi thamanan qalila, ula'ika lahum ajruhum 'inda Rabbihim, innallaha sari'ul-hisab (199) Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanus-biru wa sabiru wa rabitu wattaqullaha la'allakum tuflihun (200)} Suratu Ali 'Imran, 190-200

English.TITLE: Supplication for Putting On Clothes

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا ( الثَّوْبَ ) وَرَزَقَنِيه مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this (garment) and provided it for me, with no power or strength of my own.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أهل السنن إلا النسائي انظر إرواء الغليل 7/ 47
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadha (ath-thawb) wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

English.TITLE: Supplication for Putting On New Clothes

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوتَنِيه، أسْألك مِنْ خَيرِهِ وخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شرِّه وشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, to You is the praise; You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good of what it was made for, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what it was made for.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود والتّرمذي والبغوي وانظر مختصر شمائل التّرمذي للألباني ص 47
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma lakal-hamd, anta kasawtanih, as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah

English.TITLE: The Supplication for One Who Has Put On New Clothes

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: إِلْبَسْ جَدِيدًا وَعِشْ حَمِيدًا وَمُتْ شَهِيدًا
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wear it new, live praised, and die a martyr.
TEXT.REFERENCE: ابن ماجه 2/ 1178 والبغوي 12/ 41 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 275
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Ilbas jadidan, wa 'ish hamidan, wa mut shahidan

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: تُبْلِي وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May you wear it out, and may Allah the Exalted replace it with another.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 41، وانظر صحيح أبي داود 2/ 760
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Tubli wa yukhliful-lahu ta'ala

English.TITLE: What to Say When Taking Off One's Clothes

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي 2/ 505 وغيره وانظر الإرواء برقم 49 صحيح الجامع 3/ 203
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismillah

English.TITLE: Supplication for Entering the Toilet

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: [بِسْمِ اللَّه]، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الخُبْثِ وَالخَبَائِثِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: [In the name of Allah], O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه البخاري 1/ 45 ومسلم 1/ 283 وزيادة (بسم الله) في أوله، أخرجها سعيد بن منصور، أنظر فتح الباري 1/ 244
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: [Bismillah], Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba'ith

English.TITLE: Supplication for Leaving the Toilet

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: غُفْرَانَكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Your forgiveness [I ask].
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أصحاب السنن إلا النسائي، أخرجه في عمل اليوم والليلة انظر تخريج زاد المعاد 2/ 387
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Ghufranak

English.TITLE: The Remembrance Before Ablution

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّه
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود وابن ماجه وأحمد وانظر إرواء الغليل 1/ 122
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismillah

English.TITLE: The Remembrance After Finishing Ablution

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
TEXT.REFERENCE: رواه مسلم 1/ 209
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ المُتَطَهِّرِينَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, make me among those who repent often, and make me among those who purify themselves.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي 1/ 78 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 18
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabina waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You; I bear witness that there is no god but You. I ask Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
TEXT.REFERENCE: النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة ص 173 وانظر  إرواء الغليل 1/ 135 و 2/  94
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk

English.TITLE: The Remembrance Upon Leaving the House

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أو أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِم أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I stray or be led astray, lest I slip or be caused to slip, lest I wrong [others] or be wronged, lest I behave ignorantly or be treated ignorantly.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أهل السنن وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 152 وصحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 336
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla aw udall, aw azilla aw uzall, aw azlima aw uzlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alayy

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 4/ 325 والتّرمذي 5/ 490 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 151
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

English.TITLE: The Remembrance Upon Entering the House

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللًّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا. ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we place our trust. Then let him greet his household with peace.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 325، وحسن إسناده العلامة ابن باز في تحفة الأخيار ص 28، وفي الصحيح (إذا دخل الرجل بيته فذكر بيته فذكر الله عند دخوله وعند طعامه قال الشيطان لا مبيت لكم ولا عشاء) مسلم برقم 2018
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'alallahi Rabbina tawakkalna. Thumma liyusallim 'ala ahlih

English.TITLE: Supplication for Going to the Mosque

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورا، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُورًا، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا، وَعَظِّمْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا. اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي عَصَبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُورًا، وَفِي دَمِي نُورًا، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُورًا
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, place light in my heart, and light in my tongue, and light in my hearing, and light in my sight, and light above me, and light below me, and light on my right, and light on my left, and light before me, and light behind me, and place light in my soul, and magnify light for me, and make my light great, and grant me light, and make me light. O Allah, give me light, and place light in my sinews, and in my flesh, and in my blood, and in my hair, and in my skin.
TEXT.REFERENCE: جميع هذه الخصال في البخاري 11/ 116 برقم 6316 ومسلم 1/ 526، 529، 530 برقم 763
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nura, wa fi lisani nura, wa fi sam'i nura, wa fi basari nura, wa min fawqi nura, wa min tahti nura, wa 'an yamini nura, wa 'an shimali nura, wa min amami nura, wa min khalfi nura, waj'al fi nafsi nura, wa a'zim li nura, wa 'azzim li nura, waj'al li nura, waj'alni nura. Allahumma a'tini nura, waj'al fi 'asabi nura, wa fi lahmi nura, wa fi dami nura, wa fi sha'ri nura, wa fi bashari nura

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُورًا فِي قَبْرِي .. وَنُورًا فِي عِظَامِي
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, place for me light in my grave.. and light in my bones.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي برقم 3419، 5/ 483
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahummaj'al li nuran fi qabri.. wa nuran fi 'izami

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَزِدْنِي نُورًا، وَزِدْنِي نُورًا، وَزِدْنِي نُورًا
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And increase me in light, and increase me in light, and increase me in light.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه البخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 695، ص 258 وصحح إسناده الألباني في صحيح الأدب المفرد برقم 536
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa zidni nura, wa zidni nura, wa zidni nura

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَهَبْ لِي نُورًا عَلَى نُورٍ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And grant me light upon light.
TEXT.REFERENCE: ذكره ابن حجر في فتح الباري وعزاه إلى ابن أبي عاصم في كتاب الدعاء، انظر الفتح 11/ 118 وقال: فاجتمع من اختلاف الروايات خمس وعشرون خصلة
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa hab li nuran 'ala nur

English.TITLE: Supplication for Entering the Mosque

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ القَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I seek refuge in Allah the Almighty, and in His noble Face, and in His eternal authority, from the accursed Satan.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود وانظر صحيح الجامع برقم 4591
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: A'udhu billahil-'azim, wa biwajhihil-karim, wa sultanihil-qadim, minash-shaytanir-rajim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ* وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ** اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ***
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
TEXT.REFERENCE:
* رواه ابن السني برقم 88 وحسنه الألباني
** أبو داود 1/ 126 وانظر صحيح الجامع 1/ 528
*** رواه مسلم 1/ 494. وفي سنن ابن ماجه من حديث فاطمة رضي الله عنها (اللهم اغفر لي ذنوبي وافتح لي أبواب رحمتك) وصححه الألباني لشواهده، انظر صحيح ابن ماجه 1/ 128 - 129
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah, Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik

English.TITLE: Supplication for Leaving the Mosque

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty. O Allah, protect me from the accursed Satan.
TEXT.REFERENCE: انظر تخريج روايات الحديث السابق رقم 20 وزيادة (اللهم اعصمني من الشيطان الرجيم) لابن ماجه. انظر صحيح ابن ماجه 1/ 129
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismillah was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah, Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik, Allahumma-'simni minash-shaytanir-rajim

English.TITLE: Adhkar of the Adhan

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ المُؤَذِّنُ إِلَّا فِي (حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ) وَ (حَيَّ عَلَى الفَلَاحِ) فَيَقُولُ (لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He says the same as the caller to prayer says, except at ("Come to prayer") and ("Come to success"), where he says ("There is no power and no strength except with Allah").
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 1/ 152 ومسلم 1/ 288
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Yaqulu mithla ma yaqulul-mu'adhdhin illa fi (Hayya 'alas-salah) wa (Hayya 'alal-falah) fayaqulu (La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah)

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا وَبِالإِسْلَامِ دِينًا
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger. I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Muhammad as messenger, and with Islam as religion.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 290. يقول ذلك عقب تشهد المؤذن (ابن خزيمة 1/ 220)
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa ana ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wahdahu la sharika lah, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh, raditu billahi Rabban, wa bi-Muhammadin Rasulan wa bil-Islami Dina

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعْدَ فَرَاغِهِ مِنَ إِجَابَةِ المُؤَذِّنِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He sends blessings upon the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) after he finishes responding to the caller to prayer.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 288
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Yusalli 'alan-Nabiyyi (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam) ba'da faraghihi min ijabatil-mu'adhdhin

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ القَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الوَسِيلَةَ وَالفَضِيلَةَ، وَأبْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، [إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ المِيعَادَ]
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the established prayer, grant Muhammad the intercession and the excellence, and raise him to the praiseworthy station which You promised him. [Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.]
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 1/ 152 وما بين المعكوفين للبيهقي 1/ 410 وحسن إسناده العلامة عبد العزيز بن باز في تحفة الأخيار ص 38
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab'ath-hu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi wa'adtah, [innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad]

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: يَدْعُو لِنَفْسِهِ بَيْنَ الأَذَانِ وَالإِقَامَةِ فَإِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ حِينَئِذٍ لَا يُرَدُّ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He supplicates for himself between the adhan and the iqamah, for supplication at that time is not rejected.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي وأبو داود وأحمد وانظر إرواء الغليل 1/ 262
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Yad'u linafsihi baynal-adhani wal-iqamah, fa'innad-du'a' hinaidhin la yuradd

English.TITLE: Supplication of the Opening of the Prayer

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ المَشْرِقِ وَالمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ بِالمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالبَرَدِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the East from the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins as a white garment is cleansed of stains. O Allah, wash me of my sins with water, snow, and hail.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 1/ 181 ومسلم 1/ 419
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma ba'id bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama ba'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib, Allahumma naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, Allahummaghsilni min khatayaya bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكْ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You; blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god besides You.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أصحاب السنن الأربعة وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 77 وصحيح ابن ماجه 1/ 135
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik, wa tabaraka ismuk, wa ta'ala jadduk, wa la ilaha ghayruk

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ المُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينْ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ المُسْلِمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ المَلِكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي، وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا، إِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلَاقِ، لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَدَيْكَ، وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I have turned my face towards Him who created the heavens and the earth, inclining towards truth, and I am not of those who associate partners with Allah. Indeed, my prayer, my rites of worship, my living, and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, with no partner. Thus I have been commanded, and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the King; there is no god but You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant. I have wronged myself and acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins, for none forgives sins but You. Guide me to the best of characters, for none guides to the best of them but You, and turn away from me its evil, for none turns away from me its evil but You. Here I am, at Your service and ready to obey; all good is in Your hands, and evil is not attributed to You. I exist by You and return to You; blessed and exalted are You; I ask Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
TEXT.REFERENCE: رواه مسلم 1/ 534
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhi fataras-samawati wal-arda hanifan wa ma ana minal-mushrikin, inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi Rabbil-'alamin, la sharika lahu wa bidhalika umirtu wa ana minal-muslimin, Allahumma antal-Maliku la ilaha illa ant, anta Rabbi wa ana 'abduk, zalamtu nafsi wa'taraftu bidhanbi, faghfir li dhunubi jami'an, innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, wahdini li-ahsanil-akhlaqi la yahdi li-ahsaniha illa ant, wasrif 'anni sayyi'aha la yasrifu 'anni sayyi'aha illa ant, labbayka wa sa'dayk, wal-khayru kulluhu biyadayk, wash-sharru laysa ilayk, ana bika wa ilayk, tabarakta wa ta'alayt, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ. اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الحَّقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, Lord of Gabriel, Michael, and Israfil, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You judge between Your servants concerning that in which they used to differ. Guide me, by Your leave, to the truth of that concerning which there is disagreement; indeed You guide whomever You will to a straight path.
TEXT.REFERENCE: رواه مسلم 1/ 534
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma Rabba Jibra'ila wa Mika'ila wa Israfil, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, anta tahkumu bayna 'ibadika fima kanu fihi yakhtalifun, ihdini lima-khtulifa fihi minal-haqqi bi-idhnik, innaka tahdi man tasha'u ila siratin mustaqim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا (ثَلَاثًا). أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ: مِنْ نَفْخِهِ، وَنَفْثِهِ، وَ هَمْزِهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah is greatest, most great (three times), and praise be to Allah abundantly (three times), and glory be to Allah morning and evening (three times). I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan: from his pride, his poetry, and his madness.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أبو داود 1/ 203 وابن ماجه 1/ 265 وأحمد 4/ 85 وأخرجه مسلم عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما بنحوه وفيه قصة 1/ 420
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahu akbaru kabira (thalathan), wal-hamdu lillahi kathira (thalathan), wa subhanallahi bukratan wa asila (thalathan). A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim: min nafkhihi, wa nafthihi, wa hamzih

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ الحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الحَقُّ، وَقَوْلُكَ الحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ الحَقُّ، وَالجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ أَنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ إِلَهِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, to You is the praise; You are the light of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. To You is the praise; You are the sustainer of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. To You is the praise; You are the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. To You is the praise; to You belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. To You is the praise; You are the King of the heavens and the earth. To You is the praise; You are the Truth, Your promise is truth, Your word is truth, meeting You is truth, Paradise is truth, the Fire is truth, the Prophets are truth, Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) is truth, and the Hour is truth. O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have placed my trust, in You I have believed, to You I have turned in repentance, by You I have contended [with my opponents], and to You I have brought my case for judgment. So forgive me what I have put forward and what I have delayed, what I have concealed and what I have made known. You are the One who brings forward, and You are the One who delays; there is no god but You. You are my God; there is no god but You.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 3 و 11/ 116 و 13/ 371، 423، 465 ومسلم مختصرًا بنحوه 1/ 532
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta nurus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn, wa lakal-hamdu anta qayyimus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn, wa lakal-hamdu anta Rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn, wa lakal-hamdu laka mulkus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn, wa lakal-hamdu anta Malikus-samawati wal-ard, wa lakal-hamdu antal-haqqu, wa wa'dukal-haqq, wa qawlukal-haqq, wa liqa'ukal-haqq, wal-jannatu haqq, wan-naru haqq, wan-nabiyyuna haqq, wa Muhammadun (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam) haqq, was-sa'atu haqq, Allahumma laka aslamt, wa 'alayka tawakkalt, wa bika amant, wa ilayka anabt, wa bika khasamt, wa ilayka hakamt, faghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhart, wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lant, antal-muqaddimu wa antal-mu'akhkhiru la ilaha illa ant, anta ilahi la ilaha illa ant

English.TITLE: Supplication of Bowing (Ruku')

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ العَظِيمِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to my Lord, the Almighty.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أهل السنن وأحمد وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 83
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhana Rabbiyal-'Azim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to You; O Allah, forgive me.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 1/ 199 ومسلم 1/ 350
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdik, Allahummaghfir li

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبُّوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ المَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Most Glorious, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 353 وأبو داود 1/ 230
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subbuhun, Quddusun, Rabbul-mala'ikati war-ruh

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي، وَمَا اسْتَقَلَّ بِهِ قَدَمِي
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, to You I have bowed, in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, my sight, my brain, my bones, my sinews, and that which my feet carry, have all humbled themselves before You.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 534 والأربعة إلا ابن ماجه
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma laka raka'tu, wa bika amantu, wa laka aslamtu, khasha'a laka sam'i wa basari wa mukhkhi wa 'azmi wa 'asabi, wa mastaqalla bihi qadami

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الجَبَرُوتِ وَالمَلَكُوتِ وَالكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالعَظَمَةِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to the Possessor of might, sovereignty, pride, and greatness.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 1/ 230 والنسائي وأحمد وإسناده حسن
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhana Dhil-Jabaruti wal-Malakuti wal-Kibriya'i wal-'Azamah

English.TITLE: Supplication of Rising from Bowing

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah hears whoever praises Him.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 2/ 282
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Sami'a Allahu liman hamidah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Our Lord, to You is the praise, abundant, good, and blessed praise.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 2/ 284
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Rabbana wa lakal-hamd, hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ. أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالمَجْدِ، أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ العَبْدُ، وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: [Praise] filling the heavens and filling the earth, and filling whatever is between them, and filling whatever You wish of anything beyond that. O You who are worthy of praise and glory, most deserving of what the servant says, and all of us are Your servants. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and the might of the mighty does not benefit him against You.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 346
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Mil'as-samawati wa mil'al-ardi wa ma baynahuma, wa mil'a ma shi'ta min shay'in ba'd, ahlath-thana'i wal-majd, ahaqqu ma qalal-'abd, wa kulluna laka 'abd, Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayt, wa la mu'tiya lima mana't, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd

English.TITLE: Supplication of Prostration

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أهل السنن وأحمد وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 83
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to You; O Allah, forgive me.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري ومسلم وتقدم تخريجه برقم 34
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdik, Allahummaghfir li

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبُّوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ المَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Most Glorious, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 533 وتقدم برقم 35
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subbuhun, Quddusun, Rabbul-mala'ikati war-ruh

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ، وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الخَالِقِينَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, to You I have prostrated, in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My face has prostrated to Him who created it, formed it, and opened its hearing and sight; blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 534 وغيره
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma laka sajadtu wa bika amantu, wa laka aslamtu, sajada wajhiya lilladhi khalaqahu, wa sawwarahu, wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu, tabarakallahu ahsanul-khaliqin

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الجَبَرُوتِ وَالمَلَكُوتِ، وَالكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالعَظَمَةِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to the Possessor of might, sovereignty, pride, and greatness.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 1/ 230 وأحمد، والنسائي، وإسناده حسن
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhana Dhil-Jabaruti wal-Malakuti wal-Kibriya'i wal-'Azamah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَّتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, forgive me all of my sin, the small and the great of it, the first and the last of it, the open and the secret of it.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 350
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi kullah, diqqahu wa jillah, wa awwalahu wa akhirah, wa 'alaniyyatahu wa sirrah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your wrath, and in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot count praise upon You; You are as You have praised Yourself.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 352
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni a'udhu biridaka min sakhatik, wa bimu'afatika min 'uqubatik, wa a'udhu bika mink, la uhsi thana'an 'alayk, anta kama athnayta 'ala nafsik

English.TITLE: Supplication of Sitting Between the Two Prostrations

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: My Lord, forgive me; my Lord, forgive me.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 1/ 231 وانظر  صحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 148
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Rabbighfir li, Rabbighfir li

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, set me right, grant me well-being, provide for me, and raise me [in rank].
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أصحاب السنن إلا النسائي وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 1/ 90 وصحيح ابن ماجه 1/ 148
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahummaghfir li, warhamni, wahdini, wajburni, wa 'afini, warzuqni, warfa'ni

English.TITLE: Supplication of the Prostration of Recitation

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ {فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الخَالِقِينَ}
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: My face has prostrated to Him who created it, and opened its hearing and sight by His power and strength. {So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.}
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي 2/ 474 وأحمد 6/ 30 والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/ 220 والزيادة له
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Sajada wajhiya lilladhi khalaqahu, wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu bihawlihi wa quwwatih, {fatabarakallahu ahsanul-khaliqin}

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ أُكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْرًا، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْرًا، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْرًا، وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدْ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, record for me with You a reward for it, remove from me by it a burden, make it for me a treasure stored up with You, and accept it from me as You accepted it from Your servant David.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي 2/ 473 والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/ 219
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahummaktub li biha 'indaka ajra, wa da' 'anni biha wizra, waj'alha li 'indaka dhukhra, wa taqabbalha minni kama taqabbaltaha min 'abdika Dawud

English.TITLE: The Tashahhud

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَوَاتُ، وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: All greetings, prayers, and good things are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 1/ 13 ومسلم 1/ 301
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: At-tahiyyatu lillahi, was-salawatu, wat-tayyibat, as-salamu 'alayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, as-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-salihin, ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh

English.TITLE: The Prayer upon the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) after the Tashahhud

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى  إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send blessing upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 408
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid, Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon his wives and offspring, as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim, and bless Muhammad and his wives and offspring as You blessed the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 407 ومسلم 1/ 306 واللفظ له
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatih, kama sallayta 'ala ali Ibrahim, wa barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi kama barakta 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid

English.TITLE: The Supplication after the Final Tashahhud and Before the Taslim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَحْيَا وَالمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ المَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hell, from the trial of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 2/ 102 ومسلم 1/ 412 واللفظ لمسلم
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, wa min 'adhabi jahannam, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-Masihid-Dajjal

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ المَحْيَا وَالمَمَاتِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ المَأْثَمِ وَالمَغْرَمِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and debt.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 1/ 202 ومسلم 1/ 412
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatil-Masihid-Dajjal, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins but You; so forgive me with forgiveness from You and have mercy on me; indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 8/ 168 ومسلم 4/ 2078
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathira, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indik warhamni, innaka Antal-Ghafurur-Rahim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي. أَنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, forgive me what I have put forward and what I have delayed, what I have concealed and what I have made known, and what I have committed in excess, and what You know better than I. You are the One who brings forward, and You are the One who delays; there is no god but You.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 534
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahummaghfir li ma qaddamtu, wa ma akhkhart, wa ma asrart, wa ma a'lant, wa ma asraft, wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni. Antal-Muqaddimu, wa Antal-Mu'akhkhiru la ilaha illa ant

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 2/ 86 والنسائي 3/ 53 وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبو داود 1/ 284
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibadatik

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ البُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ العُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ القَبْرِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice, and I seek refuge in You from being returned to the most despicable age [of senility], and I seek refuge in You from the trial of this world and the punishment of the grave.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 35
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-bukhli wa a'udhu bika minal-jubn, wa a'udhu bika min an uradda ila ardhalil-'umur, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatid-dunya wa 'adhabil-qabr

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 328
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannata wa a'udhu bika minan-nar

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الخَلْقِ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الحَيَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الوَفَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ القَصْدَ فِي الغِنَى وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَأْسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لَا تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ القَضَاءِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ العَيْشِ بَعْدَ المَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَا بِزِينَةِ الإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive as long as You know life to be good for me, and cause me to die when You know death to be good for me. O Allah, I ask You for the fear of You in secret and in public, and I ask You for the word of truth in contentment and in anger, and I ask You for moderation in poverty and in wealth, and I ask You for everlasting bliss, and I ask You for the comfort of the eye that never ceases, and I ask You for contentment after the decree, and I ask You for a pleasant life after death, and I ask You for the pleasure of looking upon Your Face and the longing to meet You, without being harmed by adversity or by a misleading trial. O Allah, adorn us with the adornment of faith and make us guides who are [rightly] guided.
TEXT.REFERENCE: النسائي 4/ 54، 55 وأحمد 4/ 364 وصححه الألباني في صحيح النسائي 1/ 281
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma bi'ilmikal-ghayba wa qudratika 'alal-khalqi ahyini ma 'alimtal-hayata khayran li, wa tawaffani idha 'alimtal-wafata khayran li, Allahumma inni as'aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi wash-shahadah, wa as'aluka kalimatal-haqqi fir-rida wal-ghadab, wa as'alukal-qasda fil-ghina wal-faqr, wa as'aluka na'iman la yanfad, wa as'aluka qurrata 'aynin la tanqati', wa as'alukar-rida ba'dal-qada', wa as'aluka bardal-'aysh ba'dal-mawt, wa as'aluka ladhdhatan-nazari ila wajhika wash-shawqa ila liqa'ika fi ghayri darra'a mudirratin wa la fitnatin mudillah, Allahumma zayyinna bizinatil-imani waj'alna hudatan muhtadin

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الوَاحِدُ الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدْ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You, O Allah, by [the fact] that You are the One, the Unique, the Self-Sufficient, who begets not, nor was begotten, and there is none comparable to Him, to forgive me my sins; indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه النسائي بلفظه 3/ 52 وأحمد 4/ 338 وصححه الألباني في صحيح النسائي 1/ 280
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni as'aluka ya Allahu bi'annakal-Wahidul-Ahadus-Samadul-ladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad, an taghfira li dhunubi, innaka Antal-Ghafurur-Rahim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الحَمْدَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، المَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You, since to You belongs all praise, there is no god but You alone with no partner, the Bestower of favor, O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of majesty and honor, O Ever-Living, O Sustainer - I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
TEXT.REFERENCE: رواه أهل السنن وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 329
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi'anna lakal-hamd, la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika lak, al-Mannan, ya Badi'as-samawati wal-ard, ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram, ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, inni as'alukal-jannata wa a'udhu bika minan-nar

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدْ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You, since I bear witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You, the Unique, the Self-Sufficient, who begets not, nor was begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 2/ 62 والتّرمذي 5/ 515 وابن ماجه 2/ 1267 وأحمد 5/ 360 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 329 وصحيح التّرمذي 3/ 163
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi'anni ashhadu annaka Antallahu la ilaha illa ant, al-Ahadus-Samadul-ladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad

English.TITLE: Adhkar after Ending the Prayer with the Taslim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثَلَاثًا)، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I ask forgiveness of Allah (three times). O Allah, You are Peace, and from You comes peace; blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 414
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Astaghfirullah (thalathan), Allahumma Antas-Salam, wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and the might of the mighty does not benefit him against You.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 1/ 255 ومسلم 1/ 414
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayt, wa la mu'tiya lima mana't, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الفَضْلُ، وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الكَافِرُونَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. There is no power and no strength except with Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him; His is the favor and His is the grace, and His is the goodly praise. There is no god but Allah, sincere in devotion to Him even though the disbelievers dislike it.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 415
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, la ilaha illallah, wa la na'budu illa iyyah, lahun-ni'matu wa lahul-fadl, wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan, la ilaha illallahu mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT:
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهُ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ مَرَّةً)
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ (مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, and Allah is greatest (thirty-three times each). There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things (once).
TEXT.REFERENCE: "من قال ذلك دبر كل صلاة غفرت خطاياه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر"مسلم 1/ 418
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhanallah, walhamdu lillah, wallahu akbar (thalathan wa thalathina marrah), la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir (marratan wahidah)

TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 2/ 86 والنسائي 3/ 68 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 2/ 8 والسور الثلاث يقال لها المعوذات وانظر فتح الباري 9/ 62

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT:
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
{اللّهُ لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ}
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT:
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
{Allah - there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Footstool extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.}
TEXT.REFERENCE: من قرأها دبر كل صلاة لم يمنعه من دخول الجنة إلا أن يموت . والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 100، وابن السني برقم 121 وصححه الجامع 5/ 339 وسلسلة الأحاديث الصحيحة 2/ 697 برقم 972
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT:
A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
{Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim}

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT:
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
(بَعْدَ صَلَاةِ المَغْرِبِ وَالصُّبْحِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise; He gives life and causes death, and He is capable of all things. (After the Maghrib and Fajr prayers)
TEXT.REFERENCE: رواه التّرمذي 5/ 515 وأحمد 4/ 227 وانظر تخريجه في زاد المعاد 1/ 300
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumit, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. (Ba'da salatil-maghribi was-subh)

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT:
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
(بَعْدَ السَّلَامِ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الفَجْرِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and acceptable deeds. (After the taslim of the Fajr prayer)
TEXT.REFERENCE: ابن ماجه وغيره وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 152 ومجمع الزوائد 10/ 111
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala. (Ba'das-salami min salatil-fajr)

English.TITLE: Supplication of the Prayer of Guidance (Istikharah)

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: قَالَ جَابِرٌ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عِنْهُمَا : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يُعَلِّمُنَا الاسْتِخَارَةَ فِي الأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ القُرْآنِ، يَقُولُ : إِذَا هَمَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِالأَمْرِ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ الفَرِيضَةِ، ثُمَّ لِيَقُلْ: (اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ العَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ - وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ - خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي - أَوْ قَالَ : عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ - فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي، ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي - أَوْ قَالَ : عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ - فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Jabir ibn 'Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with both of them) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) used to teach us the prayer of guidance (istikharah) in all matters just as he taught us a surah from the Qur'an. He would say: "If one of you resolves upon a matter, let him pray two rak'ahs other than the obligatory prayer, then let him say: (O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge, and I seek ability by Your power, and I ask You of Your immense bounty, for You are able while I am not, and You know while I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter - and he names his need - is good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affair - or he said: in this world and the next - then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and then bless it for me. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affair - or he said: in this world and the next - then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it may be, and make me pleased with it.)"
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 7/ 162
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Qala Jabiru bnu 'Abdillah (radiyallahu 'anhuma): Kana Rasulullahi (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam) yu'allimuna al-istikharata fil-umuri kulliha kama yu'allimunas-surata minal-Qur'an, yaqul: Idha hamma ahadukum bil-amri falyarka' rak'atayni min ghayril-faridah, thumma liyaqul: (Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmik, wa astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'azim, fa'innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa anta 'Allamul-ghuyub, Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra -wa yusammi hajatah- khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri -aw qala: 'ajilihi wa ajilih- faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li, thumma barik li fih, wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri -aw qala: 'ajilihi wa ajilih- fasrifhu 'anni wasrifni 'anh, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kan, thumma ardini bih)

English.TITLE: Morning Adhkar

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى مَنْ لَا نَبِيَّ بَعْدَهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Praise be to Allah alone, and blessings and peace be upon him after whom there is no prophet.
TEXT.REFERENCE: عن أنس يرفعه "لأن أقعد مع قوم يذكرون الله تعالى من صلاة الغداة حتى تطلع الشمس أحب إلي من أن أعتق أربعة من ولد إسماعيل، ولأن أقعد مع قوم يذكرون الله من صلاة العصر إلى أن تغرب الشمس أحب إلي من أن أعتق أربعة"أبو داود برقم 3667، وحسنه الألباني، صحيح أبو داود 2/ 698
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Alhamdu lillahi wahdah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala man la nabiyya ba'dah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT:
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
{اللّهُ لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ}
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT:
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
{Allah - there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Footstool extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.}
TEXT.REFERENCE: سورة البقرة، آية 255، "من قالها حين يصبح أجير من الجن حتى يمسي، ومن قالها حين يمسي أجير من الجن حتى يصبح"أخرجه الحاكم 1/ 562 وصححه الألباني في صحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/ 273، وعزاه إلى النسائي والطبراني وقال : وإسناد الطبراني جيد
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT:
A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
{Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim}

TEXT.REFERENCE: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء. أبو داود 4/ 322 والتّرمذي 5/ 567 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 182

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ المُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا اليَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا اليَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي القَبْرِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: We have entered the morning and with us the dominion belongs to Allah, and praise be to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 4/ 2088
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa sharri ma ba'dah, Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar, Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nari wa 'adhabin fil-qabr

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي 5/ 466 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 142
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُك، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am [committed] to Your covenant and promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
TEXT.REFERENCE: من قالها موقنًا بها حين يمسي فمات من ليلته دخل الجنة، وكذلك إذا أصبح أخرجه البخاري 7/ 150
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma Anta Rabbi la ilaha illa Ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayy, wa abu'u bidhanbi, faghfir li, fa'innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You to witness, and calling to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation, that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.
TEXT.REFERENCE: من قالها حين يصبح وحين يمسي أربع مرات أعتقه الله من النار . أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 317 والبخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 1201 والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 9، وابن السني برقم 70 وحسن سماحة الشيخ ابن باز إسناد النسائي وأبي داود في تحفة الأخيار ص 23
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni asbahtu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu hamalata 'arshik, wa mala'ikatak, wa jami'a khalqik, annaka Antallahu la ilaha illa Anta wahdaka la sharika lak, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluk

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, whatever blessing has come this morning to me or to any of Your creation is from You alone, with no partner; so to You is the praise and to You is the thanks.
TEXT.REFERENCE: من قالها حين يصبح فقد أدي شكر يومه، ومن قالها حين يمسى فقد أدى شكر ليلته. أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 318، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 7 وابن السني برقم 41 وابن حبان "موارد"رقم 2361 وحسن ابن باز إسناده في تحفة الأخيار ص 24
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَه إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no god but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no god but You.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 4/ 324، وأحمد 5/ 42 والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 22 وابن السني برقم 69 والبخاري في الأدب المفرد، وحسن العلامة ابن باز إسناده في تحفة الأخيار ص 26
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the mighty Throne.
TEXT.REFERENCE: من قالها حين يصبح ويمسي سبع مرات كفاه الله ما أهمه من أمر الدنيا والآخرة. أخرجه ابن السني برقم 71 مرفوعًا وأبو موقوف 4/ 321، وصحح إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط. انظر زاد المعاد 2/ 376
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَفْوَ وَالعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَفْوَ وَالعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly life, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unaware from beneath me.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود وابن ماجه وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 332
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah, Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali, Allahummas-tur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati, Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi'azamatika an ughtala min tahti

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You; I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, from the evil of Satan and his association [of partners with You], and from committing evil against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي وأبو داود .انظر :صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 142
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa Malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ العَلِيمُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
TEXT.REFERENCE: من قالها ثلاثًا إذا أصبح وثلاثًا إذا أمسى لم يضره شيء أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 323 والتّرمذي 5/ 465 وابن ماجه وأحمد. انظر: صحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 332 وحسن إسناده العلامة ابن باز في تحفة الأخيار ص 39
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, and with Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) as prophet.
TEXT.REFERENCE: من قالها ثلاثًا حين يصبح وحين يمسي كان حقًا على الله أن يرضيه يوم القيامة. أحمد 4/ 337 والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 4 وابن السني برقم 68 وأبو داود 4/ 418 والتّرمذي 5/ 465 وحسنه ابن باز في تحفة الأخيار ص 39
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Raditu billahi Rabban, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam) Nabiyya

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help; set right all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
TEXT.REFERENCE: الحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/ 545 وانظر صحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/ 273
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, birahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ المُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا اليَوْمِ: فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنُورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: We have entered the morning and with us the dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its triumph, its help, its light, its blessing, and its guidance, and I seek refuge in You from the evil that is in it and the evil that follows it.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 4/ 322 وحسن إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط في تحقيق زاد المعاد 2/ 273
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin, Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal-yawm: fathahu, wa nasrahu, wa nurahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi wa sharri ma ba'dah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ المُشْرِكِينَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: We have entered the morning upon the natural disposition of Islam, and upon the word of sincere devotion, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, inclining towards truth and submitting to Allah, and he was not of those who associate partners with Allah.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أحمد 3/ 406 و 407 وابن السني في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 34 وانظر: صحيح الجامع 4/ 209
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini Nabiyyina Muhammadin (salla Allahu 'alayhi wa sallam), wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
TEXT.REFERENCE: من قالها مائة مرة حين يصبح وحين يمسي لم يأت أحد يوم القيامة بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد قال مثل ما قال أو زاد رواه مسلم 4/ 2071
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things.
TEXT.REFERENCE:
عَشرَ مَرَّاتٍ:
 النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 24 وانظر :صحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/ 272، وتحفة الأخيار لابن باز ص 44 وانظر فضلها في ص 146، حديث رقم 255

أو مرة واحدة عند الكسل
أبو داود 4/ 319 وابن ماجه وأحمد 4/ 60 وانظر :صحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/ 270، صحيح أبو داود 3/ 957، وصحيح ابن ماجه 2/ 331 وزاد المعاد 2/ 377
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things.
TEXT.REFERENCE: من قالها مائة مرة في يوم كانت له عدل عشر رقاب، وكتب له مائة حسنة، ومحيت عنه مائة سيئة، وكانت حرزًا من الشيطان يومه ذلك حتى يمسي، ولم يأت أحد بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد عمل أكثر من ذلك. البخاري 4/ 95، ومسلم 4/ 2071
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, [as many times] as the number of His creation, as pleases Him, as the weight of His Throne, and as the extent of His words.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 4/ 2090
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi 'adada khalqihi wa rida nafsihi wa zinata 'arshihi wa midada kalimatih

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and acceptable deeds.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه ابن السني في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 54 وابن ماجه برقم 925 وحسن إسناده عبد القادر وشعيب الأرناؤوط في تحقيق زاد المعاد 2/ 375
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I ask forgiveness of Allah and turn to Him in repentance.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 101، ومسلم 4/ 2075
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
TEXT.REFERENCE:
من صلى علي حين يُصبح عشرًا، وحين يُمسي عشرًا أدركتهُ شفاعتي يوم القيامة
أخرجه الطبراني بإسنادين أحدهما جيد، انظر: الزوائد 10/ 120 وصحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/ 273
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala Nabiyyina Muhammad

English.TITLE: Evening Adhkar

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى مَنْ لَا نَبِيَّ بَعْدَهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Praise be to Allah alone, and blessings and peace be upon him after whom there is no prophet.
TEXT.REFERENCE: عن أنس يرفعه "لأن أقعد مع قوم يذكرون الله تعالى من صلاة الغداة حتى تطلع الشمس أحب إلي من أن أعتق أربعة من ولد إسماعيل، ولأن أقعد مع قوم يذكرون الله من صلاة العصر إلى أن تغرب الشمس أحب إلي من أن أعتق أربعة"أبو داود برقم 3667، وحسنه الألباني، صحيح أبو داود 2/ 698
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Alhamdu lillahi wahdah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala man la nabiyya ba'dah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT:
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
{اللّهُ لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ}
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT:
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
{Allah - there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.
