TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Praise be to Allah Who has spared me from that with which He has afflicted you, and favored me greatly over many of those He created.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي 5/ 493 و 494 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 153
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani mimma-btalaka bihi wa faddalani 'ala kathirin mimman khalaqa tafdila.

English.TITLE: What is said in a gathering

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: عَنِ اِبْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي المَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ: (رَبِّ اِغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: On the authority of Ibn 'Umar, who said: It used to be counted for the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, in a single gathering, before he would rise, a hundred times: (My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, indeed You are the Ever-Accepting of repentance, the Ever-Forgiving).
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي وغيره وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 153 وصحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 321 ولفظه للتّرمذي
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: 'Anibni 'Umara qal: Kana yu'addu li-Rasulillahi sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama fil-majlisil-wahidi mi'atu marratin min qabli an yaqum: (Rabbigh-fir li wa tub 'alayya innaka antat-Tawwabul-Ghafur).

English.TITLE: The expiation for a gathering

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to You, O Allah, and by Your praise; I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أصحاب السّنن وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 153، وقد ثبت أنّ عائشة رضي اللّه عنها قالت: ما جلس رسول اللّه صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم مجلسا، ولا تلى قرآنا، ولا صلّى صلاة إلّا ختم ذلك بكلمات: '...'، أخرجه النّسائي في عمل اليوم واللّيلة برقم 308، وأحمد 6/ 77 وصحّحه الدّكتور فاروق حمادة في تحقيقه لعمل اليوم واللّيلة للنّسائي ص 273
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.

English.TITLE: The reply to one who says 'May Allah forgive you'

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَلَكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And for you (too).
TEXT.REFERENCE: أحمد 5/ 82 والنّسائي في عمل اليوم واللّيلة ص 218 برقم 421 تحقيق الدّكتور فاروق حمادة
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa lak.

English.TITLE: The supplication for one who does you a kindness

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah reward you with good.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه التّرمذي رقم 2035 وانظر صحيح الجامع 6244 وصحيح التّرمذي 2/ 200
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Jazakallahu khayra.

English.TITLE: What Allah protects one with from the Dajjal

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Whoever memorizes ten verses from the beginning of Surat al-Kahf will be protected from the Dajjal.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 555، وفي رواية من آخر الكهف 1/ 556
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Man hafiza 'ashra ayatin min awwali Surati'l-Kahfi 'usima minad-Dajjal.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَالاِسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And seeking refuge in Allah from his trial after the final tashahhud in every prayer.
TEXT.REFERENCE: انظر حديث رقم 55 وحديث رقم 56 من هذا الكتاب
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wal-isti'adhatu billahi min fitnatihi 'aqibat-tashahhudil-akhiri min kulli salah.

English.TITLE: The reply to one who says 'I love you for the sake of Allah'

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَحَبَّكَ الذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May He for Whose sake you love me, love you.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أبو داود 4/ 333، وحسّنه الألباني في صحيح سنن أبي داود 3/ 965
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Ahabbakal-ladhi ahbabtani lah.

English.TITLE: The supplication for one who offers you his wealth

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah bless for you your family and your wealth.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 4/ 88
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Barakallahu laka fi ahlika wa malik.

English.TITLE: The supplication for one who lent, upon repayment

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah bless for you your family and your wealth; indeed the reward for a loan is praise and repayment.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه النّسائي في عمل اليوم واللّيلة ص 300 وابن ماجة 2/ 809 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 55
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Barakallahu laka fi ahlika wa malik, innama jaza'us-salafil-hamdu wal-ada'.

English.TITLE: The supplication for fear of associating partners with Allah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating partners with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أحمد 4/ 403 وغيره وانظر صحيح الجامع 3/ 233 وصحيح التّرغيب والتّرهيب للألباني 1/ 19
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an ushrika bika wa ana a'lam, wa astaghfiruka lima la a'lam.

English.TITLE: The reply to one who says 'May Allah bless you'

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And may Allah bless you too.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه ابن السّني ص 138 برقم 278 وانظر الوابل الصّيب لابن القيّم ص 304 تحقيق بشير محمد عيون
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa fika barakallah.

English.TITLE: The supplication for disliking bad omens

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ لَا طَيْرَ إِلَّا طَيْرُكَ، وَلَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, there are no omens except what You decree, no good except Your good, and no god besides You.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أحمد 2/ 220، وابن السني برقم 292، وصححه الألباني في الأحاديث الصحيحة 3/ 54، رقم 1065، أما الفأل فكان يعجب النّبيّ صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم ولهذا سمع من رجل كلمة طيّبة فأعجبته فقال: (أخذنا فألك من فيك) أبو داود وأحمد، وصححه الألباني في الصحيحة 2/ 363 عند أبي الشيخ في أخلاق النّبيّ صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم ص 270
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wa la khayra illa khayruk, wa la ilaha ghayruk.

English.TITLE: The supplication for riding

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، {سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ} الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاِغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah, and praise be to Allah. {Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could not have done it ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we are returning.} Praise be to Allah, praise be to Allah, praise be to Allah. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to You, O Allah, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 3/ 34 والتّرمذي 5/ 501 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 156
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismillah, walhamdu lillah, {Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun}, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Subhanakallahumma inni zalamtu nafsi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.

English.TITLE: The supplication for travel

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، {سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ} اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ العَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ المَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ المُنْقَلَبِ فِي المَالِ وَالأَهْلِ. وَإِذَا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ: (آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. {Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could not have done it ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we are returning.} O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make easy for us this journey of ours, and fold up for us its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian of the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, the distressing sight, and an evil return in wealth and family. And when he returned, he would say these words and add to them: (Returning, repenting, worshipping, and to our Lord giving praise).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 2/ 998
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, {Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun}, Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda, Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah, Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, wal-khalifatu fil-ahl, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safar, wa ka'abatil-manzar, wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl. Wa idha raja'a qalahunna wa zada fihinna: (Ayibun, ta'ibun, 'abidun, li-Rabbina hamidun).

English.TITLE: The supplication for entering a village or town

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ القَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and what they shade, Lord of the seven earths and what they carry, Lord of the devils and what they lead astray, Lord of the winds and what they scatter, I ask You for the good of this village, the good of its people, and the good of what is in it, and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people, and the evil of what is in it.
TEXT.REFERENCE: الحاكم وصحّحه ووافقه الذّهبي 2/ 100 وابن السّني برقم 524 وحسّنه الحافظ في تخريج الأذكار 5/ 154، قال ابن باز: ورواه النّسائي بإسناد حسن. انظر تحفة الأخيار ص 37
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa ma azlaln, wa Rabbal-aradinas-sab'i wa ma aqlaln, wa Rabbash-shayatini wa ma adlaln, wa Rabbar-riyahi wa ma dharayn, as'aluka khayra hadhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahliha, wa khayra ma fiha, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ahliha, wa sharri ma fiha.

English.TITLE: The supplication for entering the marketplace

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise; He gives life and causes death, and He is Living and does not die; in His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي 5/ 491 والحاكم 1/ 538 وحسّنه الألباني في صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 21 وفي صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 152
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumit wa huwa hayyun la yamut, biyadihil-khayr wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

English.TITLE: The supplication when the mount stumbles

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 4/ 296 وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 3/ 941
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismillah.

English.TITLE: The traveler's supplication for the one staying behind

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الذِي لَا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I entrust you to Allah, Whose trusts are never lost.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أحمد 2/ 403 وابن ماجة 2/ 943 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة 2/ 133
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Astawdi'ukumullahal-ladhi la tadi'u wada'i'uh.

English.TITLE: The supplication of the one staying behind for the traveler

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and the final outcome of your deeds.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أحمد 2/ 7 والتّرمذي 5/ 499 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 2/ 155
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Astawdi'ullaha dinak, wa amanatak, wa khawatima 'amalik.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ مَا كُنْتَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sin, and make good easy for you wherever you are.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 155
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Zawwadakallahut-taqwa, wa ghafara dhanbak, wa yassara lakal-khayra haythu ma kunt.

English.TITLE: Saying Allahu Akbar and Subhan Allah while traveling

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: (كُنَّا إِذَا صَعَدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Jabir, may Allah be pleased with him, said: (When we ascended we would say Allahu Akbar, and when we descended we would say Subhan Allah).
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 135
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Qala Jabirun radiyallahu 'anh: (Kunna idha sa'idna kabbarna, wa idha nazalna sabbahna).

English.TITLE: The traveler's supplication at dawn

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سَمَّـِعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلَائِهِ عَلَيْنَا. رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: May a witness bear witness to our praising Allah and to His good favour upon us. Our Lord, be our companion and bestow Your favour upon us, seeking refuge in Allah from the Fire.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 4/ 2086 ومعنى سمِع سامع: أي شهد شاهد على حمدنا للّه تعالى على نعمه وحسن بلائه. ومعنى سمَّع سامع: بلّغ سامع قولي هذا لغيره وقال مثله تنبيها على الذِّكر في السّحر والدعاء. وقوله: ربّنا صاحبنا وأفضل علينا: أي احفظنا وحطنا واكلأنا وأفضل علينا بجزيل نعمك واصرف عنّا كلّ مكروه، شرح النّووي 17/ 39
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Sami'a sami'un bihamdillahi wa husni bala'ihi 'alayna. Rabbana sahibna, wa afdil 'alayna 'a'idhan billahi minan-nar.

English.TITLE: The supplication when stopping at a place while traveling or otherwise

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 4/ 2080
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.

English.TITLE: The remembrance for returning from travel

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: يُكِبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ ثَلَاثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He would say Allahu Akbar three times upon every elevated place, then say: There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. Returning, repenting, worshipping, and to our Lord giving praise. Allah has fulfilled His promise, given victory to His servant, and defeated the confederates alone.
TEXT.REFERENCE: كان النّبيّ صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم يقوله إذا قفل من غزو أو حجّ، البخاري 7/ 163 ومسلم 2/ 980
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Yukabbiru 'ala kulli sharafin thalatha takbiratin thumma yaqul: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulk, wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, ayibun, ta'ibun, 'abidun, li-Rabbina hamidun, sadaqallahu wa'dah, wa nasara 'abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah.

English.TITLE: What one who receives welcome or unwelcome news says

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: كَانَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ الأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: (الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ) وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: (الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: When something pleasing came to him, peace and blessings be upon him, he would say: (Praise be to Allah, by Whose favor good deeds are completed). And when something displeasing came to him, he would say: (Praise be to Allah in every circumstance).
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه ابن السّني في عمل اليوم واللّيلة، والحاكم وصحّحه 1/ 499 وصحّحه الألباني رحمه اللّه في صحيح الجامع 4/ 201
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Kana sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama idha atahul-amru yasurruhu qal: (Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi bini'matihi tatimmus-salihat), wa idha atahul-amru yakrahuhu qal: (Alhamdu lillahi 'ala kulli hal).

English.TITLE: The merit of sending blessings upon the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلَاةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْرًا)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: (Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah sends ten blessings upon him for it).
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه مسلم 1/ 288
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Man salla 'alayya salatan salla Allahu 'alayhi biha 'ashra).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (لَا تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيدًا وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ، فَإِنَّ صَلَاتَكُمْ تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (Do not make my grave a place of festive gathering, and send blessings upon me, for your blessings reach me wherever you are).
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 2/ 218 وأحمد 2/ 367 وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 2/ 383
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (La taj'alu qabri 'idan wa sallu 'alayya, fa inna salatakum tablughuni haythu kuntum).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (البَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned and he does not send blessings upon me).
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي 5/ 551 وغيره، وانظر صحيح الجامع 3/ 25 وصحيح التّرمذي 3/ 177
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Al-bakhilu man dhukirtu 'indahu falam yusalli 'alayya).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلَائِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِيَ السَّلاَمَ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (Indeed Allah has angels who travel throughout the earth conveying to me the greetings of peace from my nation).
TEXT.REFERENCE: النّسائي، والحاكم 2/ 421، وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح النّسائي 1/ 274
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Inna lillahi mala'ikatan sayyahina fil-ardi yuballighuni min ummati as-salam).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلَّا رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (There is no one who greets me with peace except that Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greeting of peace).
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود برقم 2041 وحسّنه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 1/ 383
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Ma min ahadin yusallimu 'alayya illa raddallahu 'alayya ruhi hatta arudda 'alayhis-salam).

English.TITLE: Spreading the greeting of peace

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (لَاتَدْخُلُوا الجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلَا أَدُلُّكُمُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبَتُمْ؟ أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ بَيْنَكُمْ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: (You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not guide you to something which, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread the greeting of peace among yourselves).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 74 وغيره
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Qala Rasulullahi sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (La tadkhulul-jannata hatta tu'minu, wa la tu'minu hatta tahabbu, awala adullukum 'ala shay'in idha fa'altumuhu tahababtum? Afshus-salama baynakum).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: ثَلَاثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الإِيمَانَ: (الإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، وَبَذْلُ السَّلَامِ لِلْعَالَمِ، وَالإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإِقْتَارِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Three things, whoever gathers them has gathered faith: (being fair and just, even against yourself; offering the greeting of peace to all people; and spending even when in want).
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 1/ 82 عن عمّار رضي اللّه عنه موقوفا معلّقا
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Thalathun man jama'ahunna faqad jama'al-iman: (Al-insafu min nafsik, wa badhlus-salami lil-'alam, wal-infaqu minal-iqtar).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَعَنْ عَبْدِاللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَيُّ الإِسْلَامِ خَيْرٌ؟ قَالَ: (تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرَأُ السَّلَامَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: On the authority of 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both: A man asked the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him: Which aspect of Islam is best? He said: (That you feed others food, and that you greet with peace whoever you know and whoever you do not know).
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 1/ 55 ومسلم 1/ 65
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa 'an 'Abdillahi bni 'Umara radiyallahu 'anhuma: anna rajulan sa'alan-nabiyya sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: Ayyul-Islami khayr? Qal: (Tut'imut-ta'am, wa taqra'us-salama 'ala man 'arafta wa man lam ta'rif).

English.TITLE: How to return the greeting to a disbeliever when he greets with peace

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: (وَعَلَيْكُمْ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: When the People of the Book greet you with peace, say: (And upon you).
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 42، ومسلم 4/ 1705
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Idha sallama 'alaykum ahlul-kitabi faqulu: (Wa 'alaykum).

English.TITLE: The supplication when a rooster crows or a donkey brays

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ، فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكًا. وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الحِمَارَ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَانًا
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: When you hear the crowing of roosters, ask Allah of His bounty, for they have seen an angel. And when you hear the braying of a donkey, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for it has seen a devil.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 350 ومسلم 4/ 2092
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Idha sami'tum siyahad-dikati fas'alullaha min fadlih, fa innaha ra'at malaka. Wa idha sami'tum nahiqal-himari fata'awwadhu billahi minash-shaytan, fa innahu ra'a shaytana.

English.TITLE: The supplication upon hearing dogs bark at night

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الكِلَابِ وَنَهِيقَ الحَمِيرِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ، فَإِنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: When you hear the barking of dogs and the braying of donkeys at night, seek refuge in Allah from them, for they see what you do not see.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 4/ 327 وأحمد 3/ 306 وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 3/ 961
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Idha sami'tum nubahal-kilabi wa nahiqal-hamiri billayli fata'awwadhu billahi minhum, fa innahunna yarayna ma la tarawn.

English.TITLE: The supplication for one whom you have reviled

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: (O Allah, whichever believer I have reviled, make that a means of nearness for him to You on the Day of Resurrection).
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 171 ومسلم 4/ 2007 ولفظه: فاجعلها له زكاة ورحمة
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Allahumma fa ayyuma mu'minin sababtuhu faj'al dhalika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyamah).

English.TITLE: What a Muslim says when he praises another Muslim

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمُ مَادِحًا صَاحِبَهُ لَا مَحَالَةَ، فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسَبُ فُلَانًا وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلَا أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدًا، أَحْسِبُهُ - إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ - كَذَا وَكَذَا)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: (If one of you must inevitably praise his companion, let him say: I consider so-and-so to be such, and Allah is his reckoner, and I do not claim purity for anyone before Allah — I consider him, if he knows that of him, to be such and such).
TEXT.REFERENCE: رواه مسلم 4/ 2296
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Idha kana ahadukum madihan sahibahu la mahalah, falyaqul: Ahsabu fulanan wallahu hasibuh, wa la uzakki 'alallahi ahada, ahsibuhu — in kana ya'lamu dhaka — kadha wa kadha).

English.TITLE: What a Muslim says when he is praised

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاِغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ [وَاِجْعَلْنِي خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُنُّونَ]
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: O Allah, do not hold me to account for what they say, and forgive me what they do not know, [and make me better than what they think].
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 761، وصحّح إسناده الألباني في صحيح الأدب المفرد برقم 585، وما بين المعكوفين زيادة للبيهقي في شعب الإيمان 4/ 228 من طريق آخر.
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahumma la tu'akhidhni bima yaquloon, waghfir li ma la ya'lamun, [waj'alni khayran mimma yazunnun].

English.TITLE: How the pilgrim in ihram recites the Talbiyah in Hajj or Umrah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالمُلْكُ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Indeed all praise, grace, and dominion belong to You. You have no partner.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 408، ومسلم 2/ 841
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Labbaykallahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda, wan-ni'mata, laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.

English.TITLE: Saying Allahu Akbar upon reaching the Black Corner

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: طَافَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ كُلَّمَا أَتَى الرُّكْنَ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ وَكَبَّرَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, circled the House upon a camel; every time he came to the corner, he pointed toward it with something he had and said Allahu Akbar.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 476 والمراد بالشيء: المحجن. انظر: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 472
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Tafan-nabiyyu sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama bil-bayti 'ala ba'irin kullama ata ar-rukna ashara ilayhi bishay'in 'indahu wa kabbar.

English.TITLE: The supplication between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: {رَبَّنَا ءَاتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ}
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: {Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.}
TEXT.REFERENCE: أبو داود 2/ 179، وأحمد 3/ 411 والبغوي في شرح السّنّة 7/ 128، وحسّنه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 1/ 354، والآية من سورة البقرة: 201
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: {Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar}.

English.TITLE: The supplication while standing at Safa and Marwah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَمَّا دَنَا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنَ الصَّفَا قَرَأَ {إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ} (أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ) فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى البَيْتَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ القِبْلَةَ فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرَهُ وَقَالَ: (لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ)، ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ. قَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ (الحَدِيثْ). وَفِيهِ: (فَفَعَلَ عَلَى المَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: When he, peace and blessings be upon him, drew near to Safa, he recited: {Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah}, (I begin with what Allah began with). So he began with Safa, and climbed upon it until he saw the House; then he faced the qiblah, declared Allah's oneness and His greatness, and said: (There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. There is no god but Allah alone; He fulfilled His promise, gave victory to His servant, and defeated the confederates alone.) Then he supplicated in between that. He said the like of this three times (the hadith). And in it: (He did the same on Marwah as he did on Safa).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 2/ 888، والآية من سورة البقرة: 158
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Lamma dana sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama minas-Safa qara'a {Innas-Safa wal-Marwata min sha'a'irillah}, (Abda'u bima bada'allahu bih), fabada'a bis-Safa fa raqiya 'alayhi hatta ra'al-bayta fastaqbalal-qiblata fa wahhadallaha wa kabbarahu wa qal: (La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, la ilaha illallahu wahdah, anjaza wa'dah, wa nasara 'abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah), thumma da'a bayna dhalik. Qala mithla hadha thalatha marratin (al-hadith). Wa fihi: (Fafa'ala 'alal-Marwati kama fa'ala 'alas-Safa).

English.TITLE: The supplication on the Day of 'Arafah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: خَيْرُ الدُّعَاءِ دُعَاءُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ، وَخَيْرُ مَا قُلْتُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّونَ مِنْ قَبْلِي: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: The best supplication is the supplication of the Day of 'Arafah, and the best of what I and the prophets before me have said is: There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
TEXT.REFERENCE: التّرمذي وحسّنه الألباني في صحيح التّرمذي 3/ 184، وفي الأحاديث الصّحيحة 4/ 6
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Khayrud-du'a'i du'a'u yawmi 'Arafah, wa khayru ma qultu ana wan-nabiyyuna min qabli: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

English.TITLE: The remembrance at al-Mash'ar al-Haram

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: رَكِبَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ القَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى المَشْعَرَ الحَرَامَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ القِبْلَةَ (فَدَعَاهُ، وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَلَّلَهُ، وَوَحَّدَهُ) فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفًا حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدًّا، فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He, peace and blessings be upon him, rode al-Qaswa until he reached al-Mash'ar al-Haram; he faced the qiblah, (supplicated to Him, glorified Him, declared His oneness, and affirmed His unity), and he continued standing until it grew very bright, then he departed before the sun rose.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 2/ 891
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Rakiba sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallamal-Qaswa'a hatta atal-Mash'aral-Haram, fastaqbalal-qiblata (fada'ahu, wa kabbarahu, wa hallalahu, wa wahhadahu) falam yazal waqifan hatta asfara jiddan, fadafa'a qabla an tatlu'ash-shams.

English.TITLE: Saying Allahu Akbar with every stone thrown at the Jamarat

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الجِمَارِ الثَّلَاثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، وَيَقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ القِبْلَةِ، رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الجَمْرَةِ الأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةِ. أَمَّا جَمْرَةُ العَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا وَيُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ وَيَنْصَرِفُ وَلَا يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He would say Allahu Akbar every time he threw a stone at the three Jamarat, then advance and stand supplicating facing the qiblah, raising his hands, after the first and second pillar. As for Jamrat al-'Aqabah, he would throw at it, saying Allahu Akbar with each stone, then leave without stopping there.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 3/ 583 و 3/ 584، وانظر لفظه هناك. والبخاري مع الفتح 3/ 581 ورواه مسلم أيضا.
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Yukabbiru kullama rama bihasatin 'indal-jimaris-thalath, thumma yataqaddamu, wa yaqifu yad'u mustaqbilal-qiblah, rafi'an yadayhi ba'dal-jamratil-ula wath-thaniyah. Amma jamratul-'aqabati fa yarmiha wa yukabbiru 'inda kulli hasatin wa yansarifu wa la yaqifu 'indaha.

English.TITLE: What is said in astonishment or at pleasing news

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Glory be to Allah.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 1/ 210 و 390 و 414 ومسلم 4/ 1857
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Subhanallah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allah is the Greatest.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 8/ 441 وانظر صحيح التّرمذي 2/ 103 و 2/ 235 ومسند أحمد 5/ 218
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Allahu Akbar.

English.TITLE: What one who receives pleasing news does

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِدًا شُكْرًا لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, whenever something pleasing came to him or he was made glad by it, would fall down prostrating in gratitude to Allah, Blessed and Exalted.
TEXT.REFERENCE: رواه أهل السّنن إلّا النّسائي. انظر صحيح ابن ماجة 1/ 233 وإرواء الغليل 2/ 226
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Kanan-nabiyyu sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama idha atahu amrun yasurruhu aw yusarru bihi kharra sajidan shukran lillahi tabaraka wa ta'ala.

English.TITLE: What one who feels pain in his body says

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الذِي تَأَلَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ) ثَلَاثًا. وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ: (أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Place your hand upon the part of your body that hurts and say: (In the name of Allah) three times. Then say seven times: (I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and am wary of).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 4/ 1728
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Da' yadaka 'alal-ladhi ta'allama min jasadika wa qul: (Bismillah) thalathan. Wa qul sab'a marratin: (A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir).

English.TITLE: The supplication of one who fears he might harm something with his eye

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ أَخِيهِ، أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ [فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالبَرَكَةِ] فَإِنَّ العَيْنَ حَقٌّ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: When one of you sees something in his brother, or in himself, or in his wealth that pleases him, [let him supplicate for blessing upon it], for indeed the evil eye is real.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسند أحمد 4/ 447 وابن ماجة، ومالك، وصحّحه الألباني في صحيح الجامع 1/ 212 وانظر تحقيق زاد المعاد للأرناؤوط 4/ 170
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Idha ra'a ahadukum min akhihi, aw min nafsih, aw min malihi ma yu'jibuhu [falyad'u lahu bil-barakah] fa innal-'ayna haqq.

English.TITLE: What is said at moments of fright

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: There is no god but Allah.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 6/ 181، ومسلم 4/ 2208
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: La ilaha illallah.

English.TITLE: What is said at slaughter or sacrifice

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ]، اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. [O Allah, from You and for You.] O Allah, accept this from me.
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 3/ 1557، والبيهقي 9/ 287/ ومابين المعكوفين للبيهقي 9/ 287، وغيره والجملة الأخيرة سقتها بالمعنى من رواية مسلم
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Bismillahi wallahu Akbar, [Allahumma minka wa lak], Allahumma taqabbal minni.

English.TITLE: What is said to repel the guile of rebellious devils

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ التِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرً يَا رَحْمَانُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which neither the righteous nor the sinful can pass beyond, from the evil of what He has created, made, and brought forth, and from the evil of what descends from the sky, and the evil of what ascends into it, and the evil of what He has scattered in the earth, and the evil of what comes out of it, and from the evil of the trials of night and day, and from the evil of every visitor by night, except a visitor who comes with good, O Most Merciful.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أحمد 3/ 419 بإسناد صحيح وابن السّني برقم 637 وصحّح إسناده الأرناؤوط في تخريجه للطّحاوية ص 133 وانظر مجمع الزوائد 10/ 127
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammatil-lati la yujawizuhunna barrun wa la fajirun min sharri ma khalaq, wa bara'a wa dhara'a, wa min sharri ma yanzilu minas-sama', wa min sharri ma ya'ruju fiha, wa min sharri ma dhara'a fil-ard, wa min sharri ma yakhruju minha, wa min sharri fitanil-layli wan-nahar, wa min sharri kulli tariqin illa tariqan yatruqu bikhayrin ya Rahman.

English.TITLE: Seeking forgiveness and repentance

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي اليَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: (By Allah, I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day).
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 101
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Qala Rasulullahi sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Wallahi inni la-astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayhi fil-yawmi akthara min sab'ina marrah).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي اليَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (O people, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him a hundred times a day).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 4/ 2076
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Ya ayyuhan-nasu tubu ilallahi fa inni atubu fil-yawmi ilayhi mi'ata marrah).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (مَنْ قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ العَظِيمَ الذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (Whoever says: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, besides Whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance — Allah will forgive him even if he had fled from the battle line).
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أبو داود 2/ 85 والتّرمذي 5/ 569 والحاكم وصحّحه ووافقه الذّهبي 1/ 511 وصحّحه الألباني. انظر صحيح الترمذي 3/ 182 وجامع الأصول لأحاديث الرسول صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم 4/ 389 - 390 بتحقيق الأرناؤوط
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Man qala Astaghfirullahal-'Azimal-ladhi la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu wa atubu ilayh, ghafarallahu lahu wa in kana farra minaz-zahf).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ العَبْدِ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ، فَإِنْ اِسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (The Lord is nearest to the servant during the last part of the night; so if you can be among those who remember Allah at that hour, then be so).
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه الترمذي والنسائي 1/ 279، والحاكم وانظر صحيح الترمذي 3/ 183 وجامع الأصول بتحقيق الأرناؤوط 4/ 144
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Aqrabu ma yakunur-rabbu minal-'abdi fi jawfil-laylil-akhir, fa in istata'ta an takuna mimman yadhkurullaha fi tilkas-sa'ati fakun).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ العَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (The servant is nearest to his Lord while he is prostrating, so make abundant supplication).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 1/ 350
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Aqrabu ma yakunul-'abdu min Rabbihi wa huwa sajidun fa akthirud-du'a').

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي اليَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (Indeed a veil comes over my heart, and I seek Allah's forgiveness a hundred times a day).
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه مسلم 4/ 2075 قال ابن الأثير: (ليغان على قلبي) أي ليغطى ويغشى والمراد به: السهو؛ لأنه كان صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم لا يزال في مزيد من الذكر والقربة ودوام المراقبة فإذا سها عن شيء منها في بعض الأوقات، أو نسي، عدّه ذنبا على نفسه ففزع إلى الاستغفار. انظر جامع الأصول 4/ 386
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Innahu layughanu 'ala qalbi wa inni la-astaghfirullaha fil-yawmi mi'ata marrah).

English.TITLE: The merit of saying Subhan Allah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, and Allahu Akbar

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ البَحْرِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: (Whoever says: Glory be to Allah and by His praise, a hundred times in a day, his sins are wiped away even if they were like the foam of the sea).
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 7/ 168 ومسلم 4/ 2071، وانظر: فضل من قالها مائة مرّة إذا أصبح وإذا أمسى ص 31 من هذا الكتاب.
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Man qala: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi fi yawmin mi'ata marratin huttat khatayahu wa law kanat mithla zabadil-bahr).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (مَنْ قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ، كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (Whoever says: There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things — ten times, it is as if he freed four slaves from the descendants of Isma'il).
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 7/ 67 ومسلم بلفظه 4/ 2071، وانظر فضل من قالها في اليوم مائة مرّة ص 33 من هذا الكتاب
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Man qala La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulk, wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, 'ashra mirar, kana kaman a'taqa arba'ata anfusin min waladi Isma'il).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي المِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَانِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ العَظِيمِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (Two phrases, light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful: Glory be to Allah and by His praise, glory be to Allah the Mighty).
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري 7/ 168 ومسلم 4/ 2072
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Kalimatani khafifatani 'alal-lisan, thaqilatani fil-mizan, habibatani ilar-Rahman: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, Subhanallahil-'Azim).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (لَأَنْ أَقُولَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (That I say: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest — is dearer to me than everything the sun rises upon).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 4/ 2072
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (La-an aqula Subhanallah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, ahabbu ilayya mimma tala'at 'alayhish-shams).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟) فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ: كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ: (يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ، فَيُكْتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (Is any of you unable to earn a thousand good deeds every day?) So one of those sitting with him asked: How can one of us earn a thousand good deeds? He said: (He says Subhan Allah a hundred times, and a thousand good deeds are written for him, or a thousand of his sins are wiped away).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 4/ 2073
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Ayajizu ahadukum an yaksiba kulla yawmin alfa hasanah?) Fa sa'alahu sa'ilun min julasa'ih: Kayfa yaksibu ahaduna alfa hasanah? Qal: (Yusabbihu mi'ata tasbihatin, fayuktabu lahu alfu hasanatin aw yuhattu 'anhu alfu khati'ah).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ العَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الجَنَّةِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Whoever says: Glory be to Allah the Mighty and by His praise, a palm tree is planted for him in Paradise.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه الترمذي 5/ 511 والحاكم 1/ 501 وصحّحه ووافقه الذهبي، وانظر صحيح الجامع 5/ 531 وصحيح الترمذي 3/ 160
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Man qala: Subhanallahil-'Azimi wa bihamdihi ghurisat lahu nakhlatun fil-jannah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الجَنَّةِ؟) فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: (قُلْ: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (O 'Abdullah ibn Qays, shall I not guide you to a treasure from the treasures of Paradise?) I said: Yes indeed, O Messenger of Allah. He said: (Say: There is no power and no strength except with Allah).
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 213 ومسلم 4/ 2076
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Ya 'Abdallahibna Qaysin ala adulluka 'ala kanzin min kunuzil-jannah?) Faqultu: Bala ya Rasulallah, qal: (Qul: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: وَقَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: (أَحَبُّ الكَلَامِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا يَضُرُّكَ بِأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأْتَ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: And he said, peace and blessings be upon him: (The speech most beloved to Allah is four: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest; it does not matter which of them you begin with).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 3/ 1685
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Wa qala sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam: (Ahabbul-kalami ilallahi arba': Subhanallah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, la yadurruka bi-ayyihinna bada't).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: عَلِّمْنِي كَلَامًا أَقُولُهُ، قَالَ: (قُلْ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لَاحَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ العَزِيزِ الحَكِيمِ) قَالَ: فَهَؤُلَاءِ لِرَبِّي فَمَا لِي؟ قَالَ: (قُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِي، وَاِرْحَمْنِي، وَاِهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: A bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, and said: Teach me words to say. He said: (Say: There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner; Allah is the Greatest, greatly, and praise be to Allah abundantly; glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds; there is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.) He said: These are for my Lord, so what is for me? He said: (Say: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, and provide for me).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 4/ 2072 وزَادَ أبو داود: فلمّا ولّى الأعرابي قال النّبي صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم: (لقد ملأ يديه من الخير) 1/ 220
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Ja'a a'rabiyyun ila Rasulillahi sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama faqal: 'Allimni kalaman aquluh, qal: (Qul: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, Allahu akbaru kabira, wal-hamdu lillahi kathira, Subhanallahi Rabbil-'alamin, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'Azizil-Hakim). Qal: Fa ha'ula'i li-Rabbi fama li? Qal: (Qul: Allahummagh-fir li, warhamni, wahdini, warzuqni).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الصَّلَاةَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْعُو بِهَؤُلَاءِ الكَلِمَاتِ: (اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: When a man embraced Islam, the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, would teach him the prayer, then command him to supplicate with these words: (O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me).
TEXT.REFERENCE: مسلم 4/ 2073 في رواية مسلم: "فإنّ هؤلاء تجمع لك دنياك وآخرتك"
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Kanar-rajulu idha aslama 'allamahun-nabiyyu sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallamas-salah, thumma amarahu an yad'u bihaula'il-kalimat: (Allahummagh-fir li, warhamni, wahdini, wa 'afini warzuqni).

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: إِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الدُّعَاءِ: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَأَفْضَلَ الذِّكْرِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: Indeed the best supplication is: Praise be to Allah, and the best remembrance is: There is no god but Allah.
TEXT.REFERENCE: الترمذي 5/ 462 وابن ماجة 2/ 1249 والحاكم 1/ 503 وصحّحه ووافقه الذهبي وانظر صحيح الجامع 1/ 362
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Inna afdalad-du'a': Alhamdu lillah, wa afdaladh-dhikr: La ilaha illallah.

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: البَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: The lasting righteous deeds are: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.
TEXT.REFERENCE: أحمد برقم 513 بترتيب أحمد شاكر وإسناده صحيح وانظر مجمع الزوائد 1/ 297، وعزاه ابن حجر في بلوغ المرام من رواية أبي سعيد إلى النّسائي وقال: صحّحه ابن حبان والحاكم
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Al-baqiyatus-salihat: Subhanallah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

English.TITLE: How the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, used to say Subhan Allah

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: (رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ بِيَمِينِهِ)
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT: On the authority of 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr, may Allah be pleased with them both, who said: (I saw the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, counting the tasbih on his right hand).
TEXT.REFERENCE: أخرجه أبو داود بلفظه 2/ 81 والترمذي 5/ 521 وانظر صحيح الجامع 4/ 271 برقم 4865
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: 'An 'Abdillahi bni 'Amrin radiyallahu 'anhuma qal: (Ra'aytun-nabiyya sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama ya'qidut-tasbiha biyaminih).

English.TITLE: Some kinds of goodness and comprehensive manners

TEXT.ARABIC_TEXT:
إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ - أَوْ أَمْسَيْتُمْ - فَكُفُّوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَخَلُّوهُمْ، وَأَغْلِقُوا الأَبْوَابَ وَاذْكُرُوا اِسْمَ اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَا يَفْتَحُ بَابًا مُغْلَقًا، وَأَوْكُوا قِرَبَكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اِسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَخَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اِسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضُوا عَلَيْهَا شَيْئًا، وَأَطْفِئُوا مَصَابِيحَكُمْ
وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ وَسَلَّمَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
TEXT.TRANSLATED_TEXT:
When the darkness of night falls — or when evening comes upon you — keep your children close, for the devils spread about at that time. Then, when an hour of the night has passed, let them go, and close the doors and mention the name of Allah, for Satan does not open a closed door; tie shut your waterskins and mention the name of Allah; cover your vessels and mention the name of Allah, even if only by placing something across them; and extinguish your lamps.
And may Allah send blessings, peace, and grace upon our Prophet Muhammad, and upon his family and all his companions.
TEXT.REFERENCE: البخاري مع الفتح 10/ 88 ومسلم 3/ 1595
TEXT.LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT: Idha kana junhul-layli — aw amsaytum — fakuffu sibyanakum; fa innash-shayatina tantashiru hina'idhin, fa idha dhahaba sa'atun minal-layli fakhalluhum, wa aghliqul-abwaba wadhkuru ismallah, fa innash-shaytana la yaftahu baban mughlaqa, wa awku qirabakum wadhkuru ismallah, wa khammiru aniyatakum wadhkuru ismallah, wa law an ta'ridu 'alayha shay'a, wa atfi'u masabihakum. Wa sallallahu wa sallama wa baraka 'ala nabiyyina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa ashabihi ajma'in.
